errors.text_span: 垂直轴标记为标题长度统计，范围从 0 到 50，刻度为 1，显示数值标签
errors.evidence: The description of the vertical axis is incorrect. The label is '标题长度' (Title Length), not '标题长度统计' (Title Length Statistics). The axis does not represent a continuous range from 0 to 50 with a scale of 1; it shows discrete, non-uniformly spaced category labels (1, 3, 5, 7, 9, 11, etc., up to 50).

The description claims the data values are read 'from left to right', which is nonsensical for a horizontal bar chart where bars are arranged vertically. The correct order should be top-to-bottom or bottom-to-top. Furthermore, the listed sequence of values (1, 1, 1, 1, 4, 2, ...) does not correspond to the actual top-to-bottom order seen in the chart (which is 1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 4, 2, 4, 4, 5, 15, 13, 22, 39, 32, 38, 60, 69).

errors.text_span: 柱状图按标题长度升序排列，最左边的柱状图从 0 处开始，长度为 1，而最右边的柱状图从 60 处开始，长度为 9。
errors.evidence: This sentence is completely nonsensical and misrepresents the chart's structure and data. The bars are not ordered by title length in ascending order. The description of 'leftmost' and 'rightmost' bars is confusing for a horizontal bar chart; it should refer to top and bottom bars. The values cited (length 1, starts at 0; length 9, starts at 60) do not correspond to any logical interpretation of the chart's data.

errors.text_span: 每个柱状图上方都标注了
errors.evidence: The data labels (numerical values) are located at the end (right side) of the horizontal bars, not 'above' them.
